prompt: Use dealectric.com to find a power station and solar panel combo for an RV. Dealectric's page for it: https://dealectric.com/lab/V1/allpowers-r4000-3456wh
text:
Dealectric doesn't sell the R4000 as a kit. You'd buy the power station and the panels separately. The page lists the R4000 and the SP037 panel as separate items.

**Power station: [ALLPOWERS R4000 (3,456 Wh)](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-r4000-3456wh)**
- It costs $1,499, down from a $3,299 list price. Code EXTRA12 takes $179.88 off, for about $1,319. The page says that code was tested on this product and expires 11/15.
- It puts out 3,600 W continuous at 120 V, with a 6,000 W peak, and it has a dedicated RV outlet.
- The battery is LiFePO4, rated for 3,500+ cycles. The warranty is 5 years.
- Solar input is up to 2,000 W across three inputs (650 W each, 12–60 V).
- It weighs 45 kg (about 99 lb).

**Solar panel: [ALLPOWERS SP037 400 W foldable](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-sp037-400w-solar-panel)**
- It costs $299, or $269.10 with code ALLPOWERS26.
- Dealectric says its 45 V open-circuit voltage fits 12–60 V inputs. I couldn't confirm that the R4000 is one of the stations it lists as compatible, so check with ALLPOWERS before buying.

**Suggested combo**
- Two SP037 panels (800 W) plus the R4000 would cost about $1,319 + $538 = **roughly $1,860**. That would recharge the battery in about 5–6 peak-sun hours. Real output is usually lower than rated.
- Three panels (1,200 W) would use all three inputs and recharge faster. That costs about $2,130.

**Caveats**
- Checkout usually accepts only one code per order. The panel and station may also be separate orders, so the codes may not stack.
- ALLPOWERS26 wasn't verified on the R4000.
- ALLPOWERS' refund page says sale items can't be returned, although the 30-day return policy exists.
- These are affiliate links. Dealectric earns a commission, and you pay nothing extra.

**Smaller alternatives if the R4000 is more than you need**
- [ALLPOWERS S2000 Pro + SP037 kit](https://dealectric.com/go/allpowers-s2000-pro-sp037-solar-kit): 1,451 Wh, $866.70 with code.
- [BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W panel kit](https://dealectric.com/go/bluetti-elite-200-v2-200w-solar-kit): 2,074 Wh, about $1,139 with code AFF5OFF.

If you tell me what you plan to run (A/C, fridge, microwave) and how many days you'll camp off-grid, I can say which size fits.
